subject: [PATCH v2 1/6] NFSD: Add per-export read/write I/O mode settings

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch adds per-export read/write I/O mode settings to the NFS server. It introduces two new fields, 'read-io' and 'write-io', in the struct svc_export to store these settings. The patch also updates the netlink specification to include an io-mode enum and defines NFSD_IO_BUFFERED/DONTCACHE/DIRECT in terms of it. The new options are only accessible through netlink and are parsed on cache update, with their values reported in nfsd.export/content.
